# G9 existing models vs G3: DEV results (autogenerated by make_report.py)

All numbers are DEV only (synthetic g3clips_dev det + dev-neg clips, VB8 dev/dev_v7 web clips, G3 val n=402). No holdout, no locked test split. CPU = sandbox 2 vCPU, onnxruntime, 2 threads (not a phone).
